findings: useAddPosition behavioral regression — Reverted from transactionsService.addManualTransaction back to positionService.addPosition (direct insert). transactions-all and wealth/positions-snapshot invalidations were dropped. Adding a position no longer creates a transactions record and no longer refreshes the wealth dashboard snapshot. Decide which data path is correct and align the tests to it rather than reverting the hook to satisfy tests written for the older implementation.

ASSET_CLASS_LABEL type loosening — Changed from Record<AssetType, string> to { [key in AssetType]?: string }. Call sites that index directly now get string | undefined instead of string. AddTransactionModal was the only known direct-spread consumer and was fixed explicitly. Confirm no other call site expects a guaranteed non-nullable string from this map.
